cohort: 512 fresh independent public A groups, same tiny parameter distribution; frozen methods
limitations: Independent examples from the SAME tiny parameter distribution, not larger lattices or secure ML-KEM.

Selected methods were developed on earlier data; all choices are frozen for this fresh evaluation. Reusing these outcomes to select further changes makes this cohort development data for those later changes.

Ideal probabilities are exact up to floating-point error. Instance bootstrap describes population uncertainty under this generator; shot prediction intervals describe measurement variability on the fixed cohort.
The 1024-shot primary comparison matches prior experiments; larger budgets and the trained 75% method are secondary. More shots do not improve single-shot probability or demonstrate scaling.
Retaining Babai guarantees no worsening relative to Babai, not superiority to full QAOA or classical refinement.
Classical CBD sampling uses the known secret distribution and is not confined to the QAOA box. Equal candidate counts are not equal runtime.
All-to-all compiled CX resources exclude device routing, noise and QPU duration. No hardware or quantum-advantage claim.
